title: Swissivory  “Dreaming” feat Wiz Khalifa & Gallo
htmlContent: Swissivory unleashes a very upbeat single entitled “Dreaming” and he has enlisted the services of Wiz Khalifa and Gallo Locknez to accompany him on this single.  This is the follow-up single to “Dog in Me” featuring Mount Vernon, New York legend and Ruff Ryder’s front man DMX. "On the "Dog in Me", I had to match X's voice with a hardcore hip hop beat” Swiss lamented.  “For Wiz, we decided to make the song bouncier and radio friendly, but we wanted to have substance in the message, so Gallo (who I produced the track with) gave it a bit more edge on the drums.” Both featured singles will appear on Swissisory’s upcoming album Real Dreams 2.  Dreaming showcases Swissivory’s creativity as a producer, in addition, delivering the message that we should never give up on our dreams. “this track is about overcoming all obstacles that we come across in life, to achieve your goals; against all odds" Swiss stated. Swissivory’s Real Dreams 2 project is scheduled to be released on August 25, 2017, and will featured a summer jam line-up of artists such as, DMX, Snoop Dogg, Wiz Khalifa, Busta Rhymes, N.O.R.E, Jadakiss, Beenie Man, Dead Prez, Freeway, M.O.P., Juicy J, Keith Murray, and C-Tru.  Swissivory’s new single “Dreaming” featuring Wiz Khalifa and Gallo Locknez can be streamed below! https://soundcloud.com/macmediapromo/swissivory-feat-wiz-khalifa-gallo-dreaming
